tickerText: [TENNIS] Cincinnati: Arango shocks Venus Williams 6-2, 6-2; Gibson rallies past Tagger to set up Sabalenka R2 • [SQUASH] Refaay and Hazem sweep Kolkata PSA Challenger titles; PSA Valencia final tonight in Spain • [BADMINTON] BWF Worlds open Monday in Delhi — Shi Yu Qi vs Ayush Shetty headlines R1 as India hosts for the first time in 17 years • [PICKLEBALL] Seattle PPA Challenger Day 2 — pro medal rounds underway at Sideout Tsunami through Sunday • [TABLE TENNIS] Lin/Kuai defend Malmö mixed doubles crown; five Chinese women reach singles QFs as Lebrun ends China's men's run

newsItems.title: Arango Stuns Venus in Cincinnati
newsItems.excerpt: Colombia's Emiliana Arango beat seven-time Grand Slam champion Venus Williams 6-2, 6-2 in Cincinnati — her second WTA 1000 win of 2026 — and next faces Toronto champion Iga Swiatek.

newsItems.title: Egyptians Sweep Kolkata Titles
newsItems.excerpt: Seif Refaay rallied past Mohamed Gohar and Sohayla Hazem beat Menna Walid as Egyptian players claimed both crowns at the HCL Squash PSA Challenger Tour in Kolkata.

newsItems.title: Seattle Challenger Day 2
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA Tour's Seattle Challenger enters its second day at Sideout Tsunami — a Challengers 250 stop with $10,000 purses across five pro disciplines through Aug 16.

newsItems.title: Lin & Kuai Repeat in Malmö
newsItems.excerpt: Lin Shidong and Kuai Man retained the WTT Europe Smash mixed doubles title with a 3-1 comeback over Hong Kong's Wong/Doo, while five Chinese women advanced to the singles quarter-finals.
